m.t: Mujer, 35 años de edad, con cinturón de seguridad, choque entre cinco autos.
m.e: 35-year-old female, restrained driver, five-car pile up.

m.t: ¿La caída no te mata antes que el choque?
m.e: Wouldn't the fall kill you before the crash?

m.t: Tan pronto como oyó el choque, salió corriendo de su casa.
m.e: As soon as he heard the crash, he rushed out of the house.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #331579 by danilo; English translation #268219 by CK

m.t: Tras el choque del accidente, tu cabello volvió a crecer.
m.e: After the shock of the accident, all your hair grew back.

m.e: I heard a crash at about ten o'clock last night.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1404647 by marcelostockle; English translation #372046 by saeb

m.e: The sole survivor of the crash was a baby.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1880201 by marcelostockle; English translation #44999 by CM

m.t: Pero el reporte de choque probó que no fue el caso.
m.e: But the crash report proved that wasn't the case.

m.e: That crash report -- who signed off on the expert assessment?

m.e: I get this call you're in a car crash, and I'm scared half to death.

m.e: It took him several weeks to recover from the shock.

m.e: Multi-victim car crash. Let's go!

m.e: He did not die in the collision. Actually, he had a heart attack before crashing.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1192034 by marcelostockle; English translation #1192045 by marcelostockle

m.t: Nunca olvidaré el sonido del choque.
m.e: I'll never forget the sound the crash made.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #331578 by danilo; English translation #268218 by CK

m.e: It must have been a terrible shock.

m.e: Your reaction to this painful, but foreseeable shock is different.

m.t: Esto es un choque de trenes.
m.e: This is a train wreck.

m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1467789 by marcelostockle; English translation #67896 by CK

m.e: And this shock went through my whole body.

m.e: It's only a matter of time before the meteor strikes.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1252108 by Hohen; English translation #712485 by papabear

m.e: We shock because electricity resets the current.

m.e: This is territory allied to the Red Desert clan.

m.e: We need an ambassador from the 13th clan to stay here in Polis.

m.t: - ¡Somos el Clan de los Treinta y Tantos!
m.e: -We're the Thirtysomething Gang!

m.t: ¡Eres un traidor a tu clan!

m.t: Es la desgracia del clan Hemsworth.
m.e: He's the disgrace of the Hemsworth clan.

m.t: Durotan está protegiendo a su clan.
m.e: Durotan is protecting his clan.

m.t: Tengo un clan para salvar.
m.e: I got a clan to save.

m.t: Un campeón por clan.
m.e: One champion per clan.

m.e: And yet here you are, killing for your own clan, just like everyone else.

m.t: Y esa llegó a ser mi familia, mi clan, mi país.
m.e: And that became my family, my tribe, my country.

m.e: But we need this rite and soon, to reassure the clan.

m.t: Soy leal a mi clan, a mi rey.
m.e: I'm loyal to my clan, to my king.

m.t: Hasta entonces, somos un clan.
m.e: Until then, we're one clan.

m.e: Mommy said you'd say so and that I shouldn't believe you.

m.t: ¿Por qué debería creerte después de todo lo que has hecho?
m.e: Why should I believe you after everything you've done?

m.t: Con tu pasado, no tengo motivos para creerte.
m.e: With your history, I have no reason to believe you.

m.t: Cuando eres así de linda, a la gente le gusta creerte.
m.e: Well, when you're that pretty, people want to believe you.

m.t: Roja, quiero creerte, pero lo estás haciendo imposible.
m.e: Red, I wanna believe you, but you're making it impossible.

m.e: I want to believe you... but there's still a part of me that doesn't.

m.t: ¿Por qué debería creerte cuando me has estado mintiendo?
m.e: Why should I believe you when you've been lying to me?

m.t: No vas a creerte lo que estoy viendo.
m.e: You will not believe what I'm looking at.

m.t: Puedes decirle que tienes otra copia y él tendrá que creerte.
m.e: You can tell him you have another copy, and he'll have to believe you.

m.t: Quiero creerte, pero tienes que darme algo para avanzar.
m.e: I want to believe you, but you've got to give me something to go on here.

m.t: Y aun así, ¿puedes creerte que tu padre teme que te dé malas ideas?
m.e: And yet, can you believe your daddy frets I'm putting wrong thoughts in your head?

m.t: No soy tan idiota como para creerte.
m.e: I'm not such an idiot that I believe you.

m.t: ¿Cómo se supone que iba a creerte?

m.e: Why, pray tell, should we believe you?

m.e: And why should I believe you?

m.t: Estoy casi preparado para creerte.
m.e: I'm just about prepared to believe you.

m.t: ¿Y por qué debería creerte?
m.e: And why should I believe you?

m.e: If you're gonna shoot me, then, please, get on with it.

m.t: No vas a dispararme frente a toda esta gente.

m.t: ¿Vas a dispararme de nuevo?

m.t: Pensaba dispararme con ella.

m.t: Y ahora podéis dispararme.

m.t: No vas a dispararme.
